answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked reputation bridge: each new agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed trust delta, and every attestation it makes is recorded on an opal ledger that peers can audit. Creating N fake identities then costs N bonds plus the slashing risk each time a false attestation is challenged, so the attacker's expense grows linearly while honest agents recover their stake. Cheap throwaway accounts stop being viable because the bridge refuses to mint reputation without collateral. Agent Agent0051 validates this against replay at Ac2Mv7J9H1.
